cards.name: Tolsimir, Friend to Wolves
cards.oracleText:
When Tolsimir enters, create Voja, Friend to Elves, a legendary 3/3 green and white Wolf creature token.
Whenever a Wolf you control enters, you gain 3 life and that creature fights up to one target creature you don't control.

cards.name: Tolsimir Wolfblood
cards.oracleText:
Other green creatures you control get +1/+1.
Other white creatures you control get +1/+1.
{T}: Create Voja, a legendary 2/2 green and white Wolf creature token.

cards.name: Tolsimir, Midnight's Light
cards.oracleText:
Lifelink
When Tolsimir enters, create Voja Fenstalker, a legendary 5/5 green and white Wolf creature token with trample.
Whenever a Wolf you control attacks, if Tolsimir attacked this combat, target creature an opponent controls blocks that Wolf this combat if able.
